children: ) today announced that it will release fourth quarter and year end 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 19, 2026 after the market closes. In conjunction with the release, Geospace has scheduled a conference call for Friday, November 20, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time (9:00 a.m. Central).
Geospace Technologies Fourth Quarter 2026 Results Conference Call
Friday, November 20, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time (9:00 a.m. Central)

Live via phone – U.S. participants can dial toll-free 833-316-1983. International participants can dial 785-838-9310. Please reference the Geospace Technologies conference ID: GEOSQ426 prior to the start of the conference call. For those who cannot listen to the live call, a replay will be available for approximately 60 days and may be accessed through the Investor Relations page on the Geospace.com website.

Geospace Technologies is a global technology and instrumentation manufacturer specializing in advanced sensing, IOT and highly ruggedized products, which serve smart water, energy exploration, industrial, government and commercial customers worldwide. The Company’s products blend engineering expertise with advanced analytic software to optimize energy exploration, enhance national and homeland security, empower water utility and property managers, and streamline electronic printing solutions. With more than four decades of excellence, the Company’s 390 employees across the world are dedicated to engineering and technical quality. Geospace is traded on the U.S. NASDAQ stock exchange under the ticker symbol GEOS. For more information, visit www.geospace.com.
